SELECT 'banner' AS _set, b.id, b.kind, b.title, b.subtitle, b.badge, b.image_key, b.theme, b.link_type, b.link_value, b.sort_order, b.is_active, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.starts_at, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') AS starts_at, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.ends_at, '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i') AS ends_at, (b.starts_at IS NOT NULL AND b.starts_at > NOW()) AS upcoming, (b.ends_at IS NOT NULL AND b.ends_at <= NOW()) AS ended, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.views) FROM home_banner_daily_stats s WHERE s.banner_id = b.id), 0) AS views, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.taps) FROM home_banner_daily_stats s WHERE s.banner_id = b.id), 0) AS taps, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.views) FROM home_banner_daily_stats s WHERE s.banner_id = b.id AND s.day > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 0) AS views_7d, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.taps) FROM home_banner_daily_stats s WHERE s.banner_id = b.id AND s.day > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 0) AS taps_7d, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(COALESCE(b.updated_at, b.created_at), '+00:00', '+05:30'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS changed FROM home_banners b ORDER BY b.sort_order, b.id; SELECT 'tournament' AS _set, t.code AS value, t.name, DATE_FORMAT(t.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date FROM tournaments t WHERE t.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND t.status IN ('REGISTRATION_OPEN', 'REGISTRATION_CLOSED', 'FIXTURES_READY', 'LIVE') AND t.end_date >= CURDATE(); SELECT 'tournament' AS _set, f.slug AS value, f.name, DATE_FORMAT(f.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS start_date FROM featured_tournaments f WHERE f.is_active = 1
